people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn you? Who will come to ask of your welfare?
translations.bsb: Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?
translations.kjv: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
translations.asv: For who will have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who will bemoan thee? or who will turn aside to ask of thy welfare?
